title: marineSim: spatio-temporal random forests for marine species distribution modelling under data limitation
description:
Simulation benchmark, R package (marineSim) and applied analysis code for the spatio-temporal random forest (stRF) method. stRF augments an ordinary random forest with multi scale spatial lags, temporal features and Euclidean distance fields.

The repository contains: the factorial simulation engine and benchmark (six ground-truth worlds × five sample sizes × three sampling designs × three timestep counts, six replicates); the Posidonia sinuosa seagrass case study for five Western Australian marine parks; the marineSim R package; and all code to regenerate every figure, table and number reported in the associated article.

This release accompanies the article submitted to Methods in Ecology and Evolution.
